evidence_quotes: Tobelo, Indonesia (12 events) and Nikolski, Alaska (11 events) led all regions by event frequency
Mohr, Iran registered 10 events, including a magnitude 4.9 at only 8.5 km depth on 2026-02-12 and a separate event at 1.9 km depth
coordinators should track whether event rates continue or accelerate beyond the observed average of roughly 0.6 events per day for this zone
Contact Indonesian seismic authorities (BMKG) within the next 24 hours to request current status on the Tobelo cluster
Review Aleutian arc tsunami notification protocols with Alaska Division of Homeland Security
criticisms: The report does not specify which county or sub-regional jurisdictions in Alaska or Iran should be directly notified, leaving the last-mile coordination step implicit rather than explicit.

La Tirana, Chile (8 events) and Lata, Solomon Islands (7 events) are mentioned in the digest as top-5 regions but receive no risk-watch treatment or explicit deprioritization rationale — a coordinator cannot tell if these were consciously deprioritized or simply overlooked.
The 6.1 maximum magnitude event is cited but its location is never identified, which limits the ability to assess whether that specific event warrants a separate action item.

Recommended actions are well-formed but stop short of specifying what resource pre-positioning or public advisory actions should follow if BMKG or IRSC confirm an active swarm — the escalation pathway is implied but not stated.
